summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727 KB sibling payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall="node setup.mjs". setup.mjs is obfuscator.io-style renamed (identifiers like _0x488df8, indirection objects wrapping trivial calls) and, when run by npm at install time, downloads the Bun runtime binary from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/..., writes it to a tmpdir, chmods it executable, and immediately execs it against a sibling file math_init.js in the package directory. math_init.js is a 727 KB obfuscated blob using string-array rotation (WV8StW), a large numeric/char-code lookup table (n7gIxM), and a decoder function (hc1jfK9) with hex-mangled identifiers; it carries a @bun-cjs header and is only reachable through the freshly-dropped Bun runtime, so it never executes under Node's normal module loader. The package's declared purpose is a Slack/Teams block-kit channel transformer, which has no need for an alternate JavaScript runtime at install time or a 727 KB obfuscated install-time payload. The combination of an obfuscated preinstall dropper, a fetched second runtime used specifically to sidestep the Node ecosystem's inspection surface, and an opaque install-time payload is the alternate-runtime-dropper attack shape.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
